subject: The flight deck of the colony ship ariadne at night, two officers on watch, stars in the big window. Andrea has found Lucas's notebook, the one nobody else sees. It has nine names in it, one for every death since the burn: the pods that failed in the first year, the rigger crushed in the spine, and under each name a line about who that person was. Lucas is standing with a hand out for it. Only these two officers are seen clearly; the other four at the table or on the ship are faceless: backs turned, in shadow or cut off by the frame.
